about_the_game:
Story

A shy and voluptuous woman is your new client. 

Her eyes are hungry for a strong masseuse like you. However, her body will need to be convinced gradually. A small brush here, a butt massage there, and a more daring touch while she's deeply relaxed. These are all that's necessary to leave a woman quivering in your hands.

Guide your client through many states of emotion. From a timid contained lust, to the deepest throes of pleasure, or if you are not careful, fear of a man who is too eager.

Progression

This game is designed to mimic the intricate challenges of seduction. In-game items can powerfully change the mood of your client. However, the player is always rewarded for looking closely, and patiently convincing the client to let herself feel good.

As you gain her trust, you will unlock future sessions where your client is open to trying progressively more perverse acts.

Gameplay

Your cursor is your hand. Gently move the cursor to brush sensitive areas like the hands, face, breasts, inner thighs, and between the inner thighs. Click and hold to massage all these body parts and more.

Massaging sore muscles will earn Trust Points, which can be spent on powerful tools and items, or unlock unique sexual actions and cosmetics. Higher states of Arousal and orgasms will provide a LOT of Trust Points.

Sensitive parts of the body will produce Fear if Arousal is too low, and your client will need to be massaged in order to build Trust and increase their Arousal. At full fear, all Arousal is erased.

If Fear is too high, the client cannot be given the Deepest Massage™.

Customization

Collect lots of different clothes, accessories and tools. Mix and match different outfits, and customize skin color and pubic hair level.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU Example: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Raspberry Pi 4
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support Example: Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (Compatibility) or macOS 10.15 (Forward+/Mobile)
  • Processor: x86_64 or ARM CPU (Apple Silicon) Example: Intel Core 2 Duo SU9400, Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support Example: Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
